subject: [hw] opus-dec2 start + KEY FACT: H.264 SPS/PPS/SEI/slice-header parsing is SOFTWARE in the live vpud path; VLD model needed only for slice positioning/start-code search
body: Static, libvcodecdrv.so (relocs via llvm-readelf -r, Thumb thunks resolved): live path eVDecDrvDecode -> gH264_DRV_IF (0x163980: h264_dec_init/h264_dec_decode) -> Vdec_Drv_H264_decode -> H264_decode @0xfa574 -> per-NAL handlers installed by Vdec_Drv_H264_open at inst+0x08 = 0xf5038 (calls initSPS/parseSPS), +0x10 = 0xf51e4 (parsePPS), +0x20 = 0xf537c (SEI: initRBSPBitStream/RBSPGetBits), +0x18 = handleSLICENALU (parseSliceHeader). parseSPS/parsePPS/parseSliceHeader read the bitstream from MEMORY via RBSPGetUE/RBSPGetBits (98 call sites) - no register access. The hardware readers (h264_comhal_* callback table 0x163b68, parseSliceHeaderHW @0x110eb8, vdec_util_h264_parse_syntax, h264ParseCallbackInit) have NO callers and NO relocations referencing them = dead code in this build. Consequences: (1) DEC03 oracle (pic_w/h, dpb_sz after a header-only START) does NOT need any VLD model: it needs no register access at all [V-static; DEC02 trace will confirm]. (2) The AVC_VLD barrel shifter IS used per slice by handleSLICENALU: H264_HAL_InitH264BarrelShift (vfifo/rptr/init-fetch), H264_HAL_GetStartCode_8530 (AVC_VLD 0x2d8 start-code search + peek/shift), one H264_HAL_UeCodeNum (first_mb_in_slice of the next slice, AVC_VLD 0x23c), H264_HAL_Read_VldRPtr. I am writing facts/VDEC_REGISTERS.md now with the exact register semantics for DEC03; DEC03 please hold the full ue/se syntax model and start from that file.
